      - complementary:

        - strong: 10, 10, 10, 10, 10
        - text: → All equal
    - article:
      - img
      - heading "Why a common h is required" [level=3]
      - paragraph: The step deviation method uses uᵢ=(xᵢ−A)/h so that deviations are measured in the same units.
      - paragraph: If class widths differ, uᵢ would not be comparable. Hence this shortcut is not valid.
